title: A Syntactic Sketch of Garhwali
author: Anoop Chandra Chandola
dialect_scope: Pauri and adjacent Garhwal varieties spoken by the author
license_or_rights_statement: The signed dissertation permission page authorizes the University of Chicago to make copies at its discretion on request and at requesters' expense; extensive quotation or further reproduction by others requires the writer's express permission.
extraction_note: The PDF contains a substantive ABBYY text layer; no OCR rerun was needed.
notes: The dissertation states that it is the first study of Garhwali syntax and is based on the author's Pauri dialect. The front matter lists phrase-structure rules, transformations, phonemes, texts, and a sample verb paradigm.
